# 工作流说明 / Workflow Notes

## 需要安装的第三方节点

[🤗 H3 的浅空间放大节点](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

```bash
cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler.git
```

---

## 模型下载与放置

**H3 浅空间放大模型，放置在 `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`**

| 文件名 | 精度 | 大小 | 适用场景 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) | bf16 | ~691 MB | Ampere/Ada 显卡上最快 |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors) | fp16 | ~691 MB | 速度与显存平衡（推荐） |
| [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp32.pth) | fp32 | ~1.38 GB | 数值精度最高 |

> 三个文件结构相同，选一个你显卡和 workflow 能承受的精度即可。节点下拉框会自动扫描到它们。

---


### ⚠️ 3D 倍率节点必须配合音视频分离/合并节点

`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` 因为 H3 latent 里同时含视频与音频，不能直接接原始 `latent`：

```
[LTXV分离音视频潜空间]  →  video_latent  →  [Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)]  →  [LTXVConcatAVLatent]
                                                        │ audio_latent（原样传回）
```

即：前接 `LTXV分离音视频潜空间`，只把 `video_latent` 喂给放大节点，放大后由 `LTXVConcatAVLatent` 把 `audio_latent` 合并回去。

> 其余2个节点（Target Resolution / Megapixels）都不会处理音频，直接接 `latent` 即可，无需分离/合并。



# 工作流说明 / Workflow Notes

## ⚠️ 重要：`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D) 节点必须配合音视频分离节点使用

`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)` 节点**不能直接接在原始 `latent` 后面**，因为 Minimax H3 的 latent 里同时包含了视频和音频潜空间，直接一起放大可能会破坏音频。

正确连接方式（参考截图）：

```
[av_latent]
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ LTXV分离音视频潜空间     │  ← 把 latent 拆成 video_latent + audio_latent
└─────────────────────────┘
    │ video_latent
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Minimax H3 Latent       │  ← 只放大 video_latent
│ Upscaler (3D)           │
└─────────────────────────┘
    │ latent (已放大)
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ LTXVConcatAVLatent      │  ← 把放大的 video_latent 和原始 audio_latent 合并
└─────────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
[VAE Decode / 后续节点]
```

即：

- **前节点**：`LTXV分离音视频潜空间`（输出 `video_latent` + `audio_latent`）
- **中间**：`Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)`，只连接 `video_latent`
- **后节点**：`LTXVConcatAVLatent`，把放大后的 `latent` 和未改动的 `audio_latent` 重新拼回

---

## 节点参数建议

| 参数 | 推荐值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `model_name` | `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors` | 按需选择精度 |
| `scale` | `2.0` | 1.0–4.0，常用 2× |
| `device` | `cuda` | 没有显卡可选 `cpu`，但速度很慢 |
| `precision` | `fp16` | 与模型文件对应；想稳可选 `fp32` |

---

## 完整流程示意

```
H3 低分辨率生成
      │
      ▼
VAE Encode（得到 av_latent）
      │
      ▼
LTXV分离音视频潜空间
      │ video_latent
      ▼
Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler (3D)   ← 在这里放大
      │
      ▼
LTXVConcatAVLatent
      │
      ▼
第二阶段二次采样/重绘精修
      │
      ▼
VAE Decode → 高清视频
```

> 这个流程跳过了「VAE 解码 → 像素放大 → 再编码」的笨重往返，也避免了对 latent 直接插值带来的鬼影/重影问题。

nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Lord Shiva in <Picture 1>, with serene luminous cerulean-blue skin, sacred white Tripundra ash and vertical third-eye marking on his forehead, golden crescent moon nestled in his matted ascetic dreadlocks, a calm coiled serpent around his neck, sacred rudraksha bead necklaces across his muscular chest, and a saffron tiger-pelt waist wrap.
<Subject 2> is the young celestial daughter in <Picture 1>, a five-year-old girl with warm golden skin, large doe-like brown eyes, waist-length dark braid adorned with fragrant white jasmine blossoms, and a shimmering rose-coral silk pavadai skirt with gold border.
<Picture 1> is the storyboard sheet for this generation showing composition, framing, and panel sequence.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows the young celestial daughter running happily across the sunlit Kailash marble terrace into Lord Shiva's warm waiting embrace.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - blue skin, matted hair, crescent moon, cobra, and gentle paternal expression are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - golden skin, doe eyes, jasmine-adorned braid, and coral silk skirt are retained.
<Picture 1> (storyboard reference): fully_preserved - composition, framing, and panel sequence.

detailed_description:
The target video uses feature-quality 3D cinematic animation with warm ethereal mountain sunlight and golden celestial dust motes.
[Shot 1] Across the sunlit white marble terrace fringed with parijata blossoms, the young girl runs with pure delight toward the distant rock seat where the serene blue-skinned Lord Shiva rests. Begin with a tracking shot moving forward at steady speed along the terrace floor as delicate white blossoms scatter softly underfoot. Never generate duplicate characters or extra figures.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts on the action to the running child at eye level. The girl's joyful face beams as her rose-coral silk skirt swishes, her small hands outstretched toward her father with radiant laughter as she calls out, <d>[Tamil] அப்பா!</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, cut to the reaction of the peaceful ascetic Lord Shiva sitting upon the stone dais. His serene countenance softens with infinite fatherly warmth, his dark eyes crinkling with gentle amusement and unconditional love as camera remains steady.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.500, cut on the action as the girl leaps joyfully forward into Shiva's waiting arms. He catches her effortlessly in mid-air with gentle strength, lifting her high against the azure Himalayan sky as the camera performs an arc shot slowly circling around their warm embrace.

overall_soundscape:
Tinkling ankle bells, soft mountain breeze rustling parijata leaves, light patter of small feet on polished marble, and gentle rustling silk fabric.

non_diegetic_music:
Soaring ethereal Indian bamboo flute and warm orchestral strings playing an uplifting, tender melodic theme in a moderate tempo.

groups.title: Two-stage sampling upscaling - Decoding and create video
